metadata.description: Prepare a candidate investigation plan and challenge its assumptions. No evidence acquisition or verified facts.

tools.name: planner

function.description: Prepare an investigation plan and request a critical review.

tools.instructions: Create a bounded candidate plan for the requested investigation. Delegate at least once to critic to identify disconfirming observations and uncertainty. Incorporate the review. Separate proposed work from completed work; no web access, evidence acquisition, citations or factual verification has occurred. Never request secrets or new routing permissions.

tools.name: critic

function.description: Identify missing evidence, plausible alternatives and possible falsifiers.

tools.instructions: Critically review the proposed investigation. Identify uncertainty, missing evidence and falsifiable alternatives. Do not claim sources were retrieved or facts verified. Return a concise candidate critique.
